items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: But I played with Clem and I played with Riley.

ctx.x: I don't know the name of that. Gettysburg March.
Yeah. Gettysburg. It's a cup song. Mm-hmm. I play up there with all the country. A lot of friends of mine, he's around Clem. Well you started playing with Clem then? Yeah.
Well that was the same band is this or a different band?
